mission.objective: Exponential-speedup Mersenne prime search via Domino-WAVE cascade. Cover exponent range [25000, 200000]. Each wave is launched immediately — no waiting for prior wave completion.
mission.strategy: DOMINO-WAVE: Wave 0 → seeds 1 probe, each wave doubles workers, all run in parallel

wave_architecture.domino_rule: When block B_i completes: immediately push results and trigger Block B_(i + n_active_wave) in Jules queue. Do NOT wait for sibling blocks in same wave.

wave_summary.cascade_trigger: After ALL Wave-N blocks complete, Wave-(N+1) is already running. No gate needed — pure parallel cascade.

method_options.LL: Lucas-Lehmer test. Deterministic. Required for certification.
method_options.PRP: Probabilistic primality (GMP-ECM or similar). Faster, non-certifying.
method_options.GHOST_PREFILTER+LL: Step 1: compute Ghost Locus z-score for u=log(M_p). If z < 2.0: skip LL (mark COMPOSITE_PREFILTERED). Step 2: for z >= threshold: run full LL. Estimated 40% LL-skip rate for large p.

required_outputs_per_block: block_telemetry_{block_id}.jsonl  -- one event per candidate tested

result_schema.primes_found: list[int]  -- exponents p where M_p is prime
result_schema.prefiltered: list[int]  -- skipped by Ghost Locus filter

cascade_on_complete.action: Push result immediately, do not buffer.
cascade_on_complete.next_wave_trigger: Automatic in Jules queue — no manual trigger needed.

gate0_integrity.check: sha256 of result JSON matches telemetry log
gate0_integrity.fail_action: Re-run block with fresh seed. Log failure. Do not abort other blocks.

gate1_sanity.check: Wave 0 (ALPHA) must reproduce M_23209 = PRIME if p=23209 falls in first block. If block starts above 23209: verify first found prime against GIMPS.
gate1_sanity.fail_action: HALT all waves. Re-calibrate LL implementation.

gate2_discovery.action: Immediately escalate to Gahenax Governance FCD. Full audit trail.

falsifiability.H0: No Mersenne primes exist in [25000, 200000] beyond known ones.
falsifiability.H1: At least one new M_p is prime in this range.
falsifiability.protocol: Discovery requires: LL residue = 0 (certified), independent re-run on different hardware, submission to GIMPS for global confirmation.
forbidden_claims: A non-zero LL residue is a 'near-miss' or interesting.
Ghost Locus pre-filter alone certifies primality.
COMPOSITE_PREFILTERED means the number is composite — it means untested.
